question: Quote the single report that best describes the failure, word for word.
answer: Report 50448213 best describes the failure: "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that an error 500 occurs for one study, preventing the doctor from processing the report. The device was in clinical use at the time of the event, and no adverse event or patient harm was reported (PR (b)(4)).Philips has started an investigation of this complaint."
